newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Khong Guan, four other stocks suspended.
newsitem.headline: Khong Guan, four other stocks suspended.

text.p: The stocks of Khong Guan Holdings (M) Bhd, C.I. Holdings Bhd, Hume Industries Bhd, Berjaya Leisure Bhd and Berjaya Industrial Bhd were all suspended on Friday, an official with the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said.
The official said the suspensions were all at the companies' request.
Khong Guan, which is involved in making biscuits, metal tins and other activities, closed at 21.70 ringgit on Thursday.
C.I. Holdings closed at 12.10 on Thursday. Its businesses include making and trading building and construction materials.
Shares of Hume Industries ended at 12.60 ringgit on Thursday. It makes and markets concrete, asbestos cement and steel products, furniture and other items.

Berjaya Leisure and Berjaya Industrial are part of the Berjaya group conglomerate. Berjaya Leisure is in development of hotels and resorts and operating Toto betting. Its stock closed at 2.43 ringgit on Thursday.
Berjaya Industrial provides management services and is in property investment. Its shares ended at 1.62 ringgit on Thursday.
